# Version 4.150.0
> **Skia m150 and new filters** · Released July 7, 2026 · [NuGet](https://www.nuget.org/packages/SkiaSharp/4.150.0) · [GitHub Release](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/releases/tag/v4.150.0)

> **API changes** · [SkiaSharp API diff](4.150.0/index.md) · [HarfBuzzSharp API diff](harfbuzzsharp/14.2.1/index.md)

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.150.0 upgrades to Skia m150 and adds new filter and fast-bounds APIs. The release also reduces repeated SKSurface canvas allocations, fixes small-sigma raster blurs, and updates HarfBuzz to 14.2.1. Remaining pre-v4 obsoletes now produce compile errors, and .NET Interactive support has been removed.

## Breaking Changes

- **Remaining pre-v4 obsolete members promoted to compile errors** — SKPaint text and font members and obsolete enum values from v3 now produce compile errors. Move text sizing and typeface configuration to SKFont and remove references to the obsolete enum values. ([#4195](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4195))
- **.NET Interactive support removed** — The SkiaSharp integration for .NET Interactive and Polyglot Notebooks is no longer shipped. Migrate notebooks to the standard SkiaSharp package or remain on 4.148.x. ([#4186](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4186))

## Engine

- **Skia upgraded to milestone m150** — Moves the bundled rendering engine to the chrome/m150 release line and includes a subsequent round of upstream fixes. ([#4146](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4146), [#4190](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4190))

## API Surface

- **Fast paint bounds for quick-reject culling** — SKPaint.GetFastBounds() returns conservative paint bounds so applications can reject invisible draws without performing a full draw pass. ([#4271](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4271))
- **New image and color filter factories** — SKImageFilter adds CreateCrop() and CreateEmpty(), while SKColorFilter adds CreateOverdraw() for visualizing rendering hotspots. ([#4227](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4227), [#4228](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4228), [#4229](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4229))

## Bug Fixes

- **Small-sigma raster blurs corrected** — Restores correct blur output for small sigma values by selecting the reliable raster pipeline path. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#4269](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4269))

## Lifecycle & Internals

- **SKSurface canvas wrapper reused** — Repeated SKSurface.Canvas access now returns a cached managed wrapper, avoiding allocations in rendering loops. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#4247](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4247))

## Security

- **HarfBuzz updated to 14.2.1** — Refreshes the bundled text-shaping library to HarfBuzz 14.2.1. ([#4167](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4167))

## HarfBuzzSharp 14.2.1

Updates the bundled HarfBuzz text-shaping library to 14.2.1.
